metadata.title: Resolución ARCSA-DE-020-2016-YMIH, Normativa Técnica Sanitaria Sustitutiva para el Funcionamiento del Sistema Nacional de Farmacovigilancia (SNFV)
metadata.edition: R.O. 856 of 6 October 2016; replaced by Resolución ARCSA-DE-2025-052-DASP on 4 February 2026 · Art. 38: serious 15 days, non-serious 30 days; Art. 26.1 foreign events; Art. 39 clinical studies 48 hours for research centres and investigators (Spanish)
metadata.legal_basis: ARCSA resolution published in the Registro Oficial; the official Spanish text governs.
metadata.applicability: Applicants, sponsors and market authorization holders reporting ICSRs (see the PV Info ICSR rulebook for scope).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
